name: sugar_grn_right
title: Sugar taste neurons (right side) -> feeding motor neuron MN9
description: Phase 3 core experiment on the paper snapshot (FlyWire 630). Stimulates the 21 labellar sugar-sensing gustatory receptor neurons on the right side (ids from data/reference/example.ipynb and figures.ipynb) at 100 Hz, the rate of Phase 3 run sugar_100Hz and of the MN9 readout in example.ipynb (sugarR_100Hz). 1000 ms per trial, 30 trials (the paper protocol), seed 0. Expected: the feeding motor neuron MN9 becomes active. Both MN9 neurons are on the watch list: 720575940660219265 (MN9 left in figures.ipynb) and 720575940645521262 (MN9 right, 630 id).
